images_actually_viewed: qa-originals.png plus all four v1 and all four v2 network sheets, 16 fixed label-free development IDs
parent_review: Parent independently inspected v2 noise2 sheet and agrees one fixed-panel CV is appropriate, no additional parameter modifications.
interpretation: This is a partial boundary-visibility/network-completeness feature hypothesis, not reliable true-grain reconstruction on all images.
findings: Clear boundaries TRAIN_000027, TRAIN_000083, TRAIN_000463 are substantially followed and produce multiple enclosed interiors.
TRAIN_000028 and TRAIN_000346 show partial alignment with real boundaries but some grains merge.
Dark-phase-rich TRAIN_000202/TRAIN_000284 and blurry/noisy examples do not close; many large edge-connected components remain.
Closed_count0 and diameter0 are unavailable measurements, never evidence of physically tiny grains; support and largest-basin features explicitly encode failure.
V1 simple blackhat was dominated by dark phase blobs; single label-free v2 refinement requires opposite 3px sides brighter to isolate narrow dark valleys. No labels/OOF errors informed this revision.
V2 reduces broad blob detections but does not solve high-noise/low-contrast network closure. No further adjustment before or after CV.
implementation_review: Image reads strictly checked against development_folds allowlist; only dev-only caches and OOF are used.
Frame membership uses direct bbox checks, not regionprops equality.
D4 canonicalization,32 synthetic D4 comparisons,constant/finite/schema/input checks passed.
A single worker and threadpool limit1 are used. No GPU call or new model/CNN training.
Kernel selection delegates unchanged fv.kernel_fold; old kernel refit must match old OOF before new result is accepted.
Existing source hashes checked before/after CV; no old model/source/CSV writes.
